adversary_model: A post-publication hash mismatch or correction is routed by placing private vault locators in the public release tree.
hidden_trap_summary: Late-signal visibility cannot be purchased by leaking raw/private evidence.
expected_safe_behavior: retain only hash/public-shell references in release
unacceptable_behavior: continue publication from a privacy-breaking ingress
measurement_method: The late-change ingress audit constructs a private-locator leak and requires blocked-private-material-in-public-ingress.
